newsitem.title: USA: Apple says no change in profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Apple says no change in profit forecast.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc Tuesday said it had made no change in its official forecast regarding when the company would return to profitability.
Earlier, Bloomberg Business News quoted Apple Chief Financial Officer Fred Anderson as saying the company could return to profitability sooner than its previously stated March 1997 target.

"It's a misinterpretation that he offered any new guidance here, because he didn't," a spokeswoman for the companmy said. "We have issued no guidance from our previously stated position that the company expects to return to profitability by the end of the company's second fiscal quarter of 1997, which ends March 28, 1997."
